```{r Data}
data <- read.csv(here("Data", "obesity_clean.csv"))
data <- data %>%
  mutate(Gender = as.factor(Gender),
         CALC = as.factor(CALC),
         FAVC = as.factor(FAVC),
         SCC = as.factor(SCC),

  )

data_sin_peso <- data %>%

data_onehot <- fastDummies::dummy_cols(
  data_sin_peso,
  remove_first_dummy = FALSE,  
  remove_selected_columns = TRUE
)
```

```{r }
#Matriz de distancias de Gower
malla_eps <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
malla_minPts <- seq(1, 50, by = 1)

# Todas las combinaciones
malla_param <- expand.grid(eps = malla_eps, minPts = malla_minPts)

# Ver las primeras filas
head(malla_param, 10)

print(malla_param$eps[[1]]) #El otro parametros es minPts

nrow(malla_param)
```


```{r  Db_Scan_todas}
epsFinal = malla_param$eps[[1]]
minPtsFinal = malla_param$minPts[[1]]
siluetaInicial = -1

gower_dist <- daisy(data_onehot, metric = "gower") #Calculando nuestra metrica 
D <- as.dist(gower_dist)


for(i in 1:nrow(malla_param)){
  db <- dbscan(D, eps = malla_param$eps[[i]], minPts = malla_param$minPts[[i]])
  sil <- silhouette(db$cluster, as.dist(gower_dist))
  if (mean(sil[, "sil_width"]) > siluetaInicial) {
    siluetaInicial = mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
    epsFinal = malla_param$eps[[i]]
    minPtsFinal = malla_param$minPts[[i]]
  }
}
print(paste0("Eps seleccionado: ", epsFinal))
print(paste0("MinPts seleccionado: ", minPtsFinal))

db <- dbscan(D, eps = epsFinal, minPts = minPtsFinal)
sil <- silhouette(db$cluster, as.dist(gower_dist))

print(mean(sil[, "sil_width"]))

# EPS = 0.2
# MinPts = 1
# Silueta = 0.3390998
```

```{r }
mds <- cmdscale(D, k = 2, eig = TRUE)  # k=2 dimensiones

# 3) Data frame para graficar
plot_mds <- data.frame(
  Dim1 = mds$points[, 1],
  Dim2 = mds$points[, 2],
  cluster = factor(ifelse(db$cluster == 0, "ruido", paste0("C", db$cluster)))
)

# 4) Gráfica
ggplot(plot_mds, aes(Dim1, Dim2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  labs(title = "DBSCAN (PCoA sobre distancia de Gower)",
       subtitle = "Proyección consistente con la métrica usada; Ruido = 0",
       x = "Dimensión 1", y = "Dimensión 2", color = "Cluster") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Quedandonos con solo las variables categoricas

```{r }
df_cat  <- data_sin_peso %>%
  select(where(is.factor))

#VIENDOI EL TIPO DE Df_cat
str(df_cat)

```


```{r }
# ---------- Paquetes ----------
# install.packages(c("cluster","dplyr","ggplot2","forcats"))


pam_gower_pipeline <- function(df, k_range = 1:12, na_label = "(NA)") {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(df))

  # 1) Asegurar categóricas y tratar NA como categoría
  df_cat <- df %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ fct_explicit_na(as.factor(.), na_label)))

  # 2) Distancia de Gower
  D <- daisy(df_cat, metric = "gower")  # disimilaridad en [0,1]

  # 3) Probar k por silhouette con PAM (diss=TRUE porque pasamos distancia)
  res <- lapply(k_range, function(k) {
    fit <- pam(D, k = k, diss = TRUE)
    sil <- silhouette(fit$clustering, D)
    sil_avg <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
    list(k = k, fit = fit, sil_avg = sil_avg)
  })
  best_idx <- which.max(sapply(res, `[[`, "sil_avg"))
  best <- res[[best_idx]]

  cat("Mejor k:", best$k, " | Silhouette promedio:", round(best$sil_avg, 4), "\n")

  # 4) Etiquetas finales
  clusters <- factor(best$fit$clustering)

  # 5) Proyección 2D (PCoA/MDS) y gráfico
  mds <- cmdscale(as.dist(D), k = 2, eig = TRUE)
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    Dim1 = mds$points[, 1],
    Dim2 = mds$points[, 2],
    cluster = clusters
  )

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(Dim1, Dim2, color = cluster)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9, size = 2) +
    labs(title = paste0("PAM + Gower (k = ", best$k, ")"),
         subtitle = paste("Silhouette promedio:", round(best$sil_avg, 3)),
         x = "Dim 1", y = "Dim 2", color = "Cluster") +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p)

  # 6) Devolver todo lo útil
  list(
    clusters = clusters,
    medoids = best$fit$medoids,   # índices de los representantes
    silhouette_mean = best$sil_avg,
    k = best$k,
    plot_data = plot_df
  )
}

# ---------- USO ----------
# Sustituye TU_DF por tu data frame (solo columnas categóricas)
out_pam <- pam_gower_pipeline(df_cat, k_range = 2:12)
head(out_pam$clusters)
```


```{r }
# ---------- Paquetes ----------
# install.packages(c("cluster","dplyr","ggplot2","forcats"))

hclust_gower_pipeline <- function(df, k_range = 2:12, method = "average", na_label="(NA)") {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(df))

  df_cat <- df %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ fct_explicit_na(as.factor(.), na_label)))
  D <- daisy(df_cat, metric = "gower")

  hc <- hclust(as.dist(D), method = method)

  # Evaluar k por silhouette
  evals <- lapply(k_range, function(k) {
    cl <- cutree(hc, k = k)
    sil <- silhouette(cl, D)
    list(k = k, cl = cl, sil_avg = mean(sil[, "sil_width"]))
  })
  best_idx <- which.max(sapply(evals, `[[`, "sil_avg"))
  best <- evals[[best_idx]]

  cat("Mejor k:", best$k, "| Silhouette promedio:", round(best$sil_avg, 4), "\n")

  # Proyección 2D
  mds <- cmdscale(as.dist(D), k = 2, eig = TRUE)
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    Dim1 = mds$points[, 1],
    Dim2 = mds$points[, 2],
    cluster = factor(best$cl)
  )

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(Dim1, Dim2, color = cluster)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9, size = 2) +
    labs(title = paste0("HClust (", method, ") + Gower (k = ", best$k, ")"),
         subtitle = paste("Silhouette promedio:", round(best$sil_avg, 3)),
         x = "Dim 1", y = "Dim 2", color = "Cluster") +
    theme_minimal()
  print(p)

  list(
    clusters = factor(best$cl),
    silhouette_mean = best$sil_avg,
    k = best$k,
    hclust = hc,
    plot_data = plot_df
  )
}

# ---------- USO ----------
out_hc <- hclust_gower_pipeline(df_cat, k_range = 2:12, method = "average")
head(out_hc$clusters)

```
